{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Create a copy to work with
df = trial_df.copy()

# Remove rows with sentinel value -999.0 in baseline
valid_df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Calculate the change in biomarker for each patient
valid_df['biomarker_change'] = valid_df['biomarker_final'] - valid_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Calculate mean change by arm
mean_change_by_arm = valid_df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Compute the difference between treatment and control
mean_diff = mean_change_by_arm['treatment'] - mean_change_by_arm['control']

# Display results
print('Mean biomarker change by arm:')
print(mean_change_by_arm)
print('\n')
print('Mean difference (treatment - control):', mean_diff)"}
